title: Solo Founder: Service to Product Transition
description: You run a profitable consulting business and have identified a repeatable problem worth productizing. Model the 18-month transition — how much consulting revenue to sacrifice, when to hire, and whether to build in public.

decision.prompt: Choose how you manage the consulting-to-product transition.

options.label: Hard cut — go all-in on product
options.description: Stop taking new consulting work immediately and dedicate 100% of time to the product. Fastest to market but requires significant personal runway.

options.label: Gradual transition over 6 months
options.description: Wind down consulting 20% per month while building the product. Preserves cash flow but extends time to PMF and risks divided attention.

options.label: Keep consulting, hire engineer
options.description: Maintain full consulting revenue and hire a contractor or part-time engineer to build the MVP. Slowest to your own involvement but preserves income.

monthly_consulting_revenue_usd.label: Monthly Consulting Revenue ($)
monthly_consulting_revenue_usd.description: Current reliable monthly consulting income you're willing to cannibalize.

personal_runway_months.label: Personal Runway (months)
personal_runway_months.description: How many months you can cover living expenses without consulting income.

target_mrr_usd.label: Target MRR at 18 Months ($)
target_mrr_usd.description: Monthly recurring revenue goal by month 18 to validate the transition.

initial_price_per_month_usd.label: Initial Monthly Price ($)
initial_price_per_month_usd.description: Starting price for your productized offering.

existing_audience_size.label: Existing Audience Size
existing_audience_size.description: Newsletter subscribers, Twitter/X followers, or LinkedIn connections you can leverage for early distribution.

build_in_public.label: Build in Public
build_in_public.description: Share progress publicly to build audience and attract early customers.
